{{samename|boss of [[Team Galactic]]|Cyrus}} ---- [[File:Cyrus EP135.png|thumb|250px|Cyrus]] '''Cyrus''' (Japanese: '''タマキ''' ''Tamaki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP135|Grin to Win!]]''. He is [[Sonrisa]]'s neighbor and, like many of the people in [[Bloomingvale]], a {{p|Sunflora}} {{pkmn|Trainer}}. He is known to have won the Sunflora of the Year award three times. ==History== In the {{aniseries|GS}} episode ''[[EP135|Grin to Win!]]'', {{TRT}} broke into Cyrus's greenhouse, hoping to steal a Sunflora for the upcoming [[Sunflora Festival]]. Cyrus was alerted to the heist after {{MTR}} inadvertently activated the alarm. While [[Jessie]] and [[James]] escaped, Cyrus found Meowth trapped in a net and tied him up on discovery. {{an|Misty}}, upon whispering her plan to {{Ash}}, told Cyrus that Meowth was an innocent Pokémon that must have been corrupted by the two that ran away, and convinced him to transfer Meowth into their custody. Later, Meowth translated to Sonrisa that her Sunflora, nicknamed Sunny, had been so gloomy lately because another Sunflora it used to play around with, Cyrus's earlier Sunflora called Gwendela, was not around anymore. The group asked Cyrus where Gwendela was, and Cyrus explained that he had traded that Sunflora yesterday for one of [[Nurse Joy]]'s Pokémon. Later, at the competition, Cyrus was one of the final contestants for the prize. His participating Dorabelle was shown to be humongous in comparison to regular Sunflora, being taller than an average-sized person. Cyrus and Dorabelle went on to lose to Sonrisa and Sunny. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of Cyrus's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|GS}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Cyrus |pkmn=Sunflora |type1=Grass |img=Cyrus Sunflora.png |epnum=EP135 |epname=Grin to Win! |desc=Cyrus's first {{p|Sunflora}} was briefly shown when Cyrus was talking to [[Sonrisa]] over her hedge. None of Sunflora's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Cyrus |pkmn=Sunflora |nick=Dorabelle |type1=Grass |img=Cyrus Dorabelle.png |epnum=EP135 |epname=Grin to Win! |desc=Cyrus's {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Sunflora}}, [[nickname]]d '''Dorabelle''', was entered into the [[Sunflora Festival]] held in [[Bloomingvale]] and was the runner-up to [[Sonrisa]]'s Sunflora, Sunny. It was not given a nickname in the Japanese version. The last contestants were Sunny, Dorabelle, and {{MTR}}, who was [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|dressed as a Sunflora]]. Meowth's disguise was eventually rumbled and [[James]] then activated huge mirrors, which reflected light and made Dorabelle and the other Sunflora's heads grow to immobilize them. However, {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and Sonrisa were able to send {{TRT}} blasting off. With a great smile and a dazzling performance, the judges awarded Sunny the title of winner, in favor of Dorabelle. None of Dorabelle's moves are known.}} ===Traded away=== {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Cyrus |pkmn=Sunflora |nick=Gwendela |type1=Grass |img=Nurse Joy Sunflora.png |epnum=EP135 |epname=Grin to Win! |vajp= |vaen=Rachael Lillis |desc=Cyrus had another {{p|Sunflora}}, nicknamed '''Gwendela''', which he [[trade]]d to [[Nurse Joy]]. [[Sonrisa]]'s Sunflora, nicknamed Sunny, used to play with it until it got traded away, which made Sunny gloomy.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Cyrus has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Sunflora Festival]] - Winner (three-time winner; one year before ''[[EP135|Grin to Win!]]'') * [[Sunflora Festival]] - Runner-Up (''[[EP135|Grin to Win!]]'') ==Trivia== * Cyrus is the only character of the day to share the same name as [[Cyrus|a main antagonist]] in the {{pkmn|animated series}}, although said antagonist was not introduced until [[Generation IV|two generations later]] in {{aniseries|DP}}. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Dan Green]] |cs=Radek Hoppe |fi=Antti Jaakola |fr_eu=Jean-Paul Clerbois |it=Luca Sandri (Mediaset dub)
